risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and well quantified, with improved sales, operating income, liquidity, and working-capital metrics. Risk remains elevated in Greenwood and JCSC due to weak demand, depressed marine and construction-related markets, margin pressure from material and transportation costs, and reliance on a favorable one-time litigation reserve reversal to support reported net income. The liquidity conclusion is confident, but the excerpt is incomplete and includes limited forward-looking detail.
